# Spike_State_Propagation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for propagating hidden state information across time steps using binary spike signals, where state values are encoded in spike timing or rates. Facilitates low-power, memory-efficient state tracking in neuromorphic Mamba models, critical for real-time speech recognition on edge devices.
